title: Record the confinement multiplicity sums
body:
## Summary
- Representatives 4 and 5 have seven difference multiplicities of 2, summing to 14, below the 18 edges a 20-point walk needs.
- Representatives 1, 2 and 3 sum to 21, so this count does not exclude them. No basis sample and no new kappa.

## Test plan
